events.thought:
I have fixed the Kconfig warning by adding `CONFIG_PICOLIBC=y` to `/zephyrproject/zephyr/tests/subsys/dfu/mcuboot/prj.conf`. This ensures that a compatible C library is used for the `native_sim` board, resolving the conflict with `STDOUT_CONSOLE`.

I have also fixed the runtime assertion failure in `mcuboot_interface_test_read_bank_header_size_limit`. The original code in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/subsys/dfu/boot/mcuboot.c` incorrectly handled the `header_size` check. I changed the condition in `boot_read_bank_header` from `if (header_size < v1_min_size - 1)` to `if (header_size < v1_min_size)`. This ensures that when `header_size` is one byte less than the minimum required size, the function correctly returns `-ENOMEM`, matching the expectation of the test case.

These changes should allow the build to succeed and the test suite to pass.
